_comment: Platform formats (tz section 6). Synced into table platform_formats by scripts/sync-config.sh. Brand profiles override notes/max_chars/image_aspect per platform.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.notes: Channel post with one image; the text is the photo caption, so it must fit 1024 characters. Plain text only: no markdown, no HTML tags. Short paragraphs separated by blank lines; emoji allowed if the brand uses them.

blog.label: Blog
blog.notes: Article: title, lead paragraph, 3-6 sections with subheadings, SEO description up to 160 characters, URL slug (lowercase latin, hyphens).

email.label: Email digest
email.notes: One block of the brand newsletter: title, 60-120 words, link label.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.notes: Hook in the first two lines (before 'see more'), then value, then CTA. Line breaks between short paragraphs.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.notes: Caption for one image. First line must stop the scroll. Hashtags at the end.

facebook.label: Facebook
facebook.notes: Short post (system rule: up to 500 characters).

x.label: X
x.notes: Single post or a thread of up to 5 posts, each at most 280 characters. Links count as 23 characters.
